explanation: Swap the R and A of the raven on its banners and you get Arven, as in the Arven Republic, which elects a president. Its name starts and ends with A.

claims.text: Only the answer fits clues 1 to 3.
Swap the two letters at the front of the big black bird of the crow family on its banners, and you have the start of its name.
Unlike the kingdoms around it, it elects a president.
Its name begins and ends with the letter A.
The bird on its banners is a raven.
Each distractor contradicts at least one of clues 1 to 3.

writerNotes: Invented fixture for tests, the mock backend and the e2e track (ARCHITECTURE 5.6). Not a real fact; never scheduled on the main track. Every country in the list is invented, so this ladder is solved by deduction from the list itself (R1-30). Clue 1 is wordplay (the raven, swapped, begins Arven), clue 2 sends a player searching for republic, which finds Arvenna and Évrenne, and clue 3 keeps the one that starts and ends with A. RITE round 3 (R3-04): "black bird" read as "blackbird", so clue 1 says the crow family; the clue-4 options are all kingdoms that begin and end with A, so clue 3 rules none of them out at a glance (lint X35); and clue 4 names the raven rather than spelling the answer.
